name: booking-calendar
description: Calendly-class booking flow that intersects freebusy across multiple Google Calendars. Drop-in `Book` component for public booking pages + admin settings for connecting accounts and configuring availability.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID from Google Cloud Console

BOOKING_CALENDAR_STATE_SECRET.description: 64-char hex used to HMAC OAuth state parameter (anti-CSRF)

routes.description: Build Google OAuth authorization URL for the current user
OAuth callback: exchange code for tokens, persist encrypted
List the current user's connected Google accounts (no tokens)
Make a connection the write target for new bookings
Read the current user's availability rules
Host: every meeting type, active or not
Public: active meeting types (or one, with meetingType) — only visitor-safe fields
Public: intersect freebusy across all connections, return free slots
Public: verify slot, insert event into host's Google Calendar
Host by session OR guest by cancelToken

Book.description: Public guest booking widget. Shows available slots, collects guest details, creates the booking.

userId.description: Host userId to book with (the account whose calendar gets the event)

meetingType.description: Meeting type code — usually "{{params.slug}}" on a /meet/:slug page

lang.description: es | en. Pass { "en": "en", "es": "es" } to follow the visitor's language

showHeader.description: Show the type's name, price and description above the calendar

styles.description: Tailwind class overrides keyed by slot/day/button

MeetingTypes.description: Public list of the host's active meeting types; each card links to basePath/<code>.

Settings.description: Host-only settings shell. Tabs: Connections / Availability / Bookings. Gated on app.auth.user.

allowedEmails.description: Phase 1 allow-list. If set, only these user emails can see settings. Defaults to any authenticated user.

ConnectionsList.description: Rows of connected Google accounts. Button to connect another.

ai_prompt:
## Booking Calendar Addon — Implementation Guide

### Overview
Calendly replacement. Host connects one or more Google accounts → availability rules are defined → a public `Book` component renders slots computed as the intersection of every connection's freebusy.

### Step 1: Environment
Set these in `settings/.env.json` for the site:
```
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=xxx.apps.googleusercontent.com
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=GOCSPX-...
GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI=https://<your-domain>/api/addons/booking-calendar/google/callback
BOOKING_CALENDAR_STATE_SECRET=<64-hex>
```

Register the redirect URI in Google Cloud Console under OAuth 2.0 Client.

### Step 1b: Databases
Copy `databases/bc_connections.json`, `bc_availability_rules.json` and `bc_bookings.json` into the site's `database/` folder. The addon route only sees the site's own databases — without these, every endpoint returns 500 (`Database "bc_connections" not found`).

### Step 2: Host settings page (`pages/booking/settings.json` — must be exactly this route: the OAuth callback redirects here, and `/admin*` paths are blocked by the security middleware)
```json
{
  "meta": { "title": "Booking Settings" },
  "auth": true,
  "layout": "main",
  "components": [
    {
      "component": "div",
      "attributes": { "className": "max-w-4xl mx-auto px-6 py-12" },
      "components": [
        { "component": "h1", "attributes": { "className": "text-3xl font-bold mb-8" }, "innerHTML": "Booking calendar" },
        { "component": "@addons/booking-calendar/Settings" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### Step 3: Meeting types + public pages
Create the meeting types in Settings → "Meeting types" (code, name ES/EN, description, price, duration, weekly hours). Each code gets its own page.

`pages/meet.json` — the list:
```json
{ "layout": "main", "components": [
  { "component": "@addons/booking-calendar/MeetingTypes",
    "attributes": { "userId": "<host user id>", "basePath": "/meet", "lang": { "en": "en", "es": "es" } } } ] }
```

`pages/meet/type.json` + `settings/routes.json` → `"meet/:slug": { "page": "meet/type" }`:
```json
{ "layout": "main", "components": [
  { "component": "@addons/booking-calendar/Book",
    "attributes": { "userId": "<host user id>", "meetingType": "{{params.slug}}", "lang": { "en": "en", "es": "es" } } } ] }
```
`<host user id>`: the userId stored on the host's bc_availability_rules rows (public read). A `fetch_data` on `users` by email resolved empty on a real site — hardcode the id.
`lang` as `{ "en": "en", "es": "es" }` lets the framework's i18n hand the component the visitor's language (Spanish is the default).
Paid types (priceCents > 0) are refused by bookings/create with 402 until checkout is wired.

### Notes
- Token fields are encrypted at rest via schema `encrypted: true` (handled by framework).
- `getAvailableSlots` is rate-limited (30 req/min per IP).
- Double-booking is prevented by a partial unique index on confirmed bookings.
- Phase 1 supports a single meeting type (`default`, 30 min). More types in Phase 2.
